Although WhatsApp has long provided a search function on the chat information page, the app is now developing a quicker way for users to access search directly within conversations. Details are as follows.

WhatsApp is developing a faster search process on iOS

WhatsApp users should know that there are two main ways to search for past messages within the app. The first is from the main chat list, where the search covers all conversations. The second is from an individual chat's information page, which searches only within that specific conversation.

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp may soon add a faster way for users to find past messages within a conversation.

The site noted that the latest WhatsApp TestFlight version contains references to a search button that will appear in the bottom-right corner of the screen when the user begins scrolling up through the chat history.

WABetaInfo reports:

The site noted that the in-conversation search tool will return the same results as the current chat information page search function. However, the new button should make the search process faster, as users can access search without leaving the conversation.

WABetaInfo noted that the button is not yet available to beta testers. The feature is still in development and is expected to roll out in a future TestFlight update before appearing in the official release.
